_comment: What the attendant at the gas station says. station.hint.<thing>.soon is a part that will need replacing shortly,
.now one that needs it now (AttendantCheck). {where} is the corner ("front left") or the axle ("front"), {car} the
car's short name, {quarts} the oil short as station.oil_short.* says it ("a quart"). A pool with several lines says one of them at random.

station.greeting: Nice {car}. Fill it up for you?
Pull up a little more... that's it. Fill 'er up?
station.greeting.towed: Ran her dry, huh? Happens to the best of us. Let's get some gas in her.
The tow truck brought you in, I see. Let's fill her up so she gets you home.
station.filled: There you go, full to the neck.
All full. I got your windshield too.
station.oil.low: Your dipstick's reading {quarts} low. I'd put some in.
station.oil.very_low: Mister, your dipstick's near dry: {quarts} low. You keep driving her like that and you'll spin a bearing.
You're {quarts} low on oil. That engine's running on fumes down there.
station.oil.topped: Oil's topped up to the mark.
Put the oil in. She's full.
station.washed: Shines like the day she left the showroom.
station.all_good: Everything else looks good under the hood.
Belts, hoses, the rest of her looks fine to me.
station.hint.radiator.soon: Your radiator's weeping at the seams. It would need a replacement shortly.
That radiator's getting tired: I can see green crust on the tank. You'll want a new one before long.
station.hint.radiator.now: Your radiator's leaking pretty good. I wouldn't go far on it: it needs replacing now.
That radiator's shot, mister. She'll boil over the first hot night if you don't replace it.
station.hint.water_pump.soon: The water pump's dripping from the weep hole. It'll need replacing soon.
I can hear the water pump bearing whining. Won't be long before it goes.
station.hint.water_pump.now: Your water pump's about to quit: there's coolant all over the front of the block.
That water pump's wobbling on its shaft. Replace it before it takes the radiator with it.
station.hint.fan.soon: The fan's got a wobble to it. The clutch is going.
Your fan blade's out of true. I'd have it looked at.
station.hint.fan.now: That fan's about to come apart. I'd replace it before it goes through the radiator.
station.hint.exhaust.soon: Your exhaust is starting to blow somewhere. You'll need a new one soon.
I can hear a tick from the exhaust. A gasket, or the pipe's rusting through.
station.hint.exhaust.now: Your exhaust has a hole in it you could put a fist through. Needs replacing now.
That exhaust's rotted out, mister. You'll be breathing fumes.
station.hint.air_filter.soon: Your air filter's getting dark. A new one's cheap.
That air filter's seen better days. I'd swap it next time.
station.hint.air_filter.now: Your air filter is black as coal. She's choking on it.
Mister, that air filter's done. Replace it and she'll breathe again.
station.hint.carburettor.soon: She's running a little rich at idle. The carb could use a rebuild before long.
I smell gas around the carburettor. The gaskets are going.
station.hint.carburettor.now: That carb's flooding: black smoke at idle and gas on the manifold. It needs a rebuild now.
Your carburettor's worn out. She won't idle right till it's rebuilt or replaced.
station.hint.clutch.soon: Your clutch was slipping a little when you pulled in. It won't last forever.
I smelled the clutch as you rolled up. It's getting thin.
station.hint.clutch.now: That clutch is slipping bad. Replace it before it leaves you stranded.
station.hint.engine.soon: I heard a little knock as you pulled in. I wouldn't lean on that engine too hard.
She's smoking a bit on the overrun. That engine's getting tired.
station.hint.engine.now: That engine's knocking loud, mister. I'd have the bottom end looked at before it lets go.
Hear that knock? That's a rod bearing on its way out.
station.hint.gearbox.soon: I heard it crunch into gear on the way in. The synchros are going.
Your gearbox whines a little. It'll need looking at.
station.hint.gearbox.now: That gearbox is grinding bad. It's got to come out and be rebuilt.
station.hint.tyre.soon: Your {where} tyre's getting thin. You'll want a new one soon.
The tread's getting low on the {where} tyre.
station.hint.tyre.now: Your {where} tyre is bald, mister. I can see the cords. Replace it now.
That {where} tyre won't hold another hard run. It's down to nothing.
station.hint.brakes.soon: Your {where} brakes squealed on the way in. The linings are getting thin.
I'd keep an eye on your {where} brakes. They're wearing down.
station.hint.brakes.now: Your {where} brakes are grinding metal on metal. Get them replaced before you need them.
Those {where} brakes are gone, mister. I heard them from inside.
station.hint.shocks.soon: The {where} end bounces a bit when I lean on it. The shocks are getting soft.
Your {where} shocks are wearing out. She floats a little.
station.hint.shocks.now: The {where} end bounces like a boat. Those shocks are shot.
Your {where} shocks are done: she kept bouncing when I leaned on the fender.
